integrations.name: GitHub Spec Kit
integrations.notes: Optional because Auto Company already defines a core artifact flow. Use Spec Kit when you want its full CLI and convergence workflow; do not create duplicate sources of truth.

integrations.name: gstack
integrations.role: founder, architecture, design, QA, and release critique

claude: Follow the reviewed installation instructions from https://github.com/garrytan/gstack and install only the roles you plan to invoke.
codex: Follow the reviewed installation instructions from https://github.com/garrytan/gstack using its Codex host option.

integrations.notes: Use selected review skills, not a second competing end-to-end orchestrator. Pin a reviewed release or commit.

integrations.name: Superpowers
integrations.role: TDD, systematic debugging, worktrees, review, and verification

codex: Open /plugins, search for Superpowers, and install the curated plugin.

integrations.notes: Activate selectively. Full subagent review on every tiny task can consume unnecessary context and time.

integrations.name: UI UX Pro Max
integrations.role: design-system exploration, UI patterns, charts, mobile and dashboard guidance
integrations.notes: Use for visual option generation after the user flow and information architecture are defined.

integrations.name: Interface Design
integrations.role: persistent design decisions and consistency for apps, dashboards, and admin tools
integrations.notes: Persist the selected design direction once; do not let multiple design skills redefine it independently.

integrations.name: Official Expo Skills
integrations.role: Expo Router, native UI, design systems, data, upgrades, EAS, and releases
integrations.notes: Treat Expo documentation and CLI output as source of truth.

integrations.name: Callstack Agent Skills
integrations.role: production React Native performance, navigation, testing, device automation, and upgrades

codex: Open /plugins, search for React Native bundles from Callstack, and install only the needed bundle.

integrations.notes: Complements Expo skills; it does not replace Expo-specific source-of-truth guidance.

integrations.name: Wondel.ai Skills
integrations.role: selected product, UX, architecture, growth, and code-quality frameworks

claude: Install only selected collections such as product-strategy, systems-architecture, or ux-design.

integrations.notes: Do not install every collection by default. Select only the frameworks required by the current product phase.

integrations.name: Product Manager Skills

claude: Review the license and install only for permitted non-commercial/internal use.
codex: Review the license and install only for permitted non-commercial/internal use.

integrations.notes: Reference-only by default. Do not vendor or redistribute its content in a commercial toolkit without permission.
